title: cyperus flavidus var. nilagiricus
intro:
Cyperus flavidus var. nilagiricus, commonly known as Nilagiri flatsedge, is a variant of the Cyperus flavidus plant species, which belongs to the sedge family and is native to the tropical regions of India.

This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nilagiri flatsedge include treating fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
